en_title: Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Sold Over 400K Copies Across Console and PC a Month After Day-One Game Pass Launch
cn_title: 《战争机器：事变日》据报销量超40万
subtitle: 口碑未能转化为销量
opus_summary: 据报道，《战争机器：事变日》主机与PC版销量超过40万份，订阅服务可能是销量偏低的原因。分析机构估计，约170万玩家通过订阅游玩，而非直接购买游戏。

paragraphs.en: Sources tell The Verge that Gears of War: E-Day has sold over 400,000 copies across console and PC, and Game Pass is likely to blame.
paragraphs.cn: 消息人士向The Verge透露，《战争机器：事变日》主机与PC版合计销量超过40万份，而Game Pass很可能是销量偏低的原因。

paragraphs.en: The latest entry in the Gears franchise released to critical acclaim earlier this month, drawing high scores from reviewers and fans alike. (IGN scored the game a 9 out of 10 , saying its “stellar story campaign is complemented by an excellent multiplayer suite.”)
paragraphs.cn: 这部《战争机器》系列新作于本月早些时候发售后广受好评，媒体和玩家都给出了高分。（IGN为本作打出9分，满分10分，称其「不仅有精彩的剧情战役，还有出色的多人模式相辅相成」。）

paragraphs.en: However, it seems the title’s popularity isn’t translating to sales — at least, that’s according to a new figure reported by The Verge . Correspondent Tom Warren cited a source who estimated that 400,000 copies of the game have been sold in total across consoles and PC, which paints a grim figure considering the prestige of this particular release.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，这款游戏的人气似乎并未转化为销量——至少The Verge最新报道的数据是如此。记者Tom Warren援引一位消息人士的估算称，本作主机与PC版合计售出40万份。考虑到这部作品的分量，这个数字实在不容乐观。

paragraphs.en: Many are pointing to Xbox Game Pass as the reason for this surprisingly low figure. The game was a day-one release on the service, and was available for early access five days before its official launch via a $30 Premium Edition Upgrade, meaning that total units sold are most certainly lower than those who accessed the title through Game Pass. (It’s also worth noting that most players were under the impression this would be a multiplatform release until Xbox revealed it as a console exclusive just four months before launch.)
paragraphs.cn: 不少人认为，销量低得出乎意料，原因在于XBOX Game Pass。本作首发便加入该服务，玩家还可购买30美元(约合人民币200元)的高级版升级包，比正式发售提前五天游玩。因此，游戏的售出份数几乎肯定低于通过Game Pass游玩的玩家人数。（另外值得一提的是，直到发售前仅四个月，XBOX才宣布本作在主机端独占，此前大多数玩家都以为它会登陆多个平台。）

paragraphs.en: Data from Alinea Analytics appears to corroborate this thought. As laid out in an October 9 post from the research firm’s head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, an estimated 1.7 million players accessed E-Day using their Game Pass subscription, rather than buying a copy.
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics的数据似乎也印证了这一看法。这家研究公司的市场分析负责人Rhys Elliott在10月9日发布的文章中指出，估计有170万玩家通过Game Pass订阅游玩《战争机器：事变日》，而不是购买游戏。

paragraphs.en: Elliott figured that of those 1.7 million players, likely 722,000 paid for the Premium upgrade, with the game prompting an additional 250,000 Premium upgrades between October 1 and the game’s full release on October 6.
paragraphs.cn: Elliott估计，这170万玩家中，可能有72.2万人付费购买了高级版升级包。从10月1日到游戏于10月6日正式发售期间，本作又带动了25万份高级版升级包的销售。

paragraphs.en: As told by Elliott at the time of his post, “E-Day sold 62,000 copies on Xbox against 722,000 Premium upgrades, so for every one copy sold on Xbox, nearly 12 Game Pass upgrades were sold.” He surmised that Xbox accounted for nearly three-quarters of the game’s total revenue, but said that despite these seemingly low numbers, nearly 950K likely paid for the game in some way — just not by outright purchasing an actual copy.
paragraphs.cn: Elliott在当时的文章中表示：「《战争机器：事变日》在XBOX上售出了62,000份，而高级版升级包卖出了72.2万份。因此，XBOX上每卖出一份游戏，就有近12份面向Game Pass玩家的升级包售出。」他推测，XBOX贡献了游戏总收入的近四分之三。不过他也表示，尽管这些数字看起来偏低，但可能有近95万人以某种形式为这款游戏付过费，只是没有直接购买游戏本体。

paragraphs.en: These E-Day figures follow news that Xbox Game Pass might be receiving a major overhaul that could let subscribers pick which features they want to actually pay for. As told by Fortune , this would include "add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure, according to people familiar with the strategy."
paragraphs.cn: 在《战争机器：事变日》这些数据曝光之前，有消息称XBOX Game Pass可能迎来重大调整，让订阅用户自行选择愿意付费的功能。《财富》报道称：「据知情人士透露，这一方案将采用分级结构，提供仅限主机的游戏、云游戏和多人游戏等附加项目。」

paragraphs.en: It’s a turbulent time for Xbox, which is still in the midst of a massive restructuring . A total of 3,200 employees are expected to lose their jobs at the company, as told by CEO Asha Sharma this summer. This restructuring has also resulted in the divestment of several game studios, including Arkane Lyon, who now has until December 13, 2026 to find a buyer and save its highly-anticipated Blade game .
paragraphs.cn: XBOX正值动荡时期，大规模重组仍在继续。首席执行官Asha Sharma今年夏天表示，公司预计将裁员3,200人。此次重组还导致多家游戏工作室被剥离，其中包括Arkane Lyon。该工作室必须在2026年12月13日之前找到买家，才能保住备受期待的《刀锋战士》游戏。
